from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess

os.umask(0o077)
root = Path('/Users/weiloon/Projects/rust-go/Foundry-Go')
output = root / '.cache/t-series/t01/cost-r1'
output.mkdir()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('release_measurement', root / 'tools/measure-release.py')
measurement = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(measurement)
runner = measurement.Runner(output, 600)
go = '/usr/local/go/bin/go'
env = {k: os.environ[k] for k in ('PATH', 'HOME', 'TMPDIR', 'LANG', 'LC_ALL') if k in os.environ}
env.update(GOENV='off', GOTOOLCHAIN='local', GOWORK='off', GOFLAGS='-mod=readonly', GOPROXY='off', DEVELOPER_DIR='/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools')
env['PATH'] = '/usr/local/go/bin:' + env['PATH']
foundry = output / 'foundry'
runner.run('prepare-generator', [go, 'build', '-o', foundry, './cmd/foundry'], root, env)
bench = runner.run('benchmarks', [go, 'test', '-run', '^$', '-bench', '^BenchmarkGenericEnvelope', '-benchmem', '-count=5', './genericdto'], root / 'tests/fixtures/consumer', env)

source = (root / 'tests/fixtures/consumer/genericdto/envelope.go').read_text()
source = re.sub(r'//foundry:dto\ntype UserEnvelope struct \{.*?\n\}\n\n', '', source, flags=re.S)
source = re.sub(r'//foundry:dto\ntype Combined struct \{.*?\n\}\n\n', '', source, flags=re.S)
generic_template = re.search(r'//foundry:dto\ntype Envelope\[T any\] struct \{.*?\n\}', source, flags=re.S).group()
concrete = source.replace(generic_template, generic_template.replace('Envelope[T any]', 'UserEnvelope').replace('Data  T ', 'Data  UserDTO ') + '\n\n' + generic_template.replace('Envelope[T any]', 'ProjectEnvelope').replace('Data  T ', 'Data  ProjectDTO '))
for t, descriptor in (('UserDTO', 'UserEnvelope'), ('ProjectDTO', 'ProjectEnvelope')):
    concrete = concrete.replace('EnvelopeJSON(' + t + 'JSON())', descriptor + 'JSON()')
    concrete = concrete.replace('Envelope[' + t + ']', descriptor)
    concrete = concrete.replace('EnvelopeValidationFields[' + t + ']()', descriptor + 'ValidationFields()')
module = (root / 'tests/fixtures/consumer/go.mod').read_text()
module = module.replace('=> ../../..', '=> ' + str(root)).replace('=> ../plugin_base', '=> ' + str(root / 'tests/fixtures/plugin_base')).replace('=> ../plugin_dep', '=> ' + str(root / 'tests/fixtures/plugin_dep'))
profiles = {}
for name, text in (('generic', source), ('concrete', concrete)):
    consumer = output / name
    package = consumer / 'genericdto'
    package.mkdir(parents=True)
    (consumer / 'go.mod').write_text(module)
    (consumer / 'go.sum').write_bytes((root / 'tests/fixtures/consumer/go.sum').read_bytes())
    dto = package / 'envelope.go'
    dto.write_text(text)
    runner.run(name + '-format', ['/usr/local/go/bin/gofmt', '-w', dto], consumer, env)
    original = dto.read_text()
    generation_env = dict(env, GOCACHE=str(output / (name + '-generation-cache')))
    generate = [foundry, 'generate', '--recursive', '--dir', consumer]
    runner.run(name + '-generation-cold', generate, consumer, generation_env)
    initial = measurement.generated_inventory(consumer)
    runner.run(name + '-generation-unchanged', generate, consumer, generation_env)
    if initial != measurement.generated_inventory(consumer):
        raise ValueError('unchanged generation changed output')
    build_env = dict(env, GOCACHE=str(output / (name + '-build-cache')))
    runner.run(name + '-build-cold', [go, 'build', './...'], consumer, build_env)
    runner.run(name + '-build-unchanged', [go, 'build', './...'], consumer, build_env)
    marker = 'type UserDTO struct {'
    assert original.count(marker) == 1
    dto.write_text(original.replace(marker, marker + '\n\tMeasurement value.Optional[string] `json:"measurement,omitzero"`'))
    runner.run(name + '-format-edit', ['/usr/local/go/bin/gofmt', '-w', dto], consumer, env)
    runner.run(name + '-generation-edited', generate, consumer, generation_env)
    edited = measurement.generated_inventory(consumer)
    if initial == edited:
        raise ValueError('DTO edit did not reach generated source')
    runner.run(name + '-build-edited', [go, 'build', './...'], consumer, build_env)
    generated = sorted(package.glob('*_foundry.gen.go'))
    profiles[name] = dict(generated_initial=initial, generated_edited=edited,
                          generated_imports=sorted(set(re.findall(r'"(github.com/[^"\n]+)"', '\n'.join(p.read_text() for p in generated)))),
                          source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(original.encode()).hexdigest())

report = dict(scope='Native local source checkout. Equivalent two-endpoint generic versus concrete envelope consumers; independent Go build caches, existing module cache, no downloaded packages. Single sequential cost sample per state; five steady-state benchmark samples. Private copies only.',
              profiles=profiles, commands=runner.results, benchmarks=bench)
measurement.write_json(output / 'report.json', report)
print(json.dumps({'report': str(output / 'report.json')}), flush=True)

source = '''package genericdto
import (
 "net/http/httptest"
 "strings"
 "testing"
)
func BenchmarkT01HTTP(b *testing.B) {
 router,err:=Router();if err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}
 body:=`{"id":"0193fd8c-2075-7000-8000-000000000001","name":"typed","note":null,"sequence":9223372036854775807}`
 b.ReportAllocs()
 for b.Loop(){
  request:=httptest.NewRequest("POST","/generic/echo",strings.NewReader(body))
  request.Header.Set("Content-Type","application/json")
  response:=httptest.NewRecorder()
  router.ServeHTTP(response,request)
  if response.Code!=200{b.Fatal(response.Code,response.Body.String())}
 }
}
'''
results = {}
for name in ('generic', 'concrete'):
    consumer = output / name
    (consumer / 'genericdto/http_bench_test.go').write_text(source)
    results[name] = runner.run(name, ['/usr/local/go/bin/go', 'test', '-run', '^$', '-bench', '^BenchmarkT01HTTP$', '-benchmem', '-count=5', './genericdto'], consumer, dict(env, GOCACHE=str(output / (name+'-build-cache'))))
measurement.write_json(stage / 'report.json', dict(scope='Full in-process typed HTTP echo, including httptest request/recorder allocation. Same private two-endpoint profiles as generation/build measurement, after identical optional field edit. Sequential, five samples each.', source=source, results=results, commands=runner.results))
